text.en:
Sections one and two of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and thirty-seven are hereby
amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. The sum of thirty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase and distribution of copies of the book entitled 'The Junior
Citizen,' by Leandro H. Fernandez.
"Section 2. Said copies shall be distributed free of charge to the pupils of the public schools enrolled in such
grades of intermediate instruction as the Director of Education may designate."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 17, 1922.
